claims.claim: The FAILURE writer and exact remote FAILURE reader gates share a finite 16 MiB budget; ordinary artifact transport retains its 1 MiB budget.

The generated 6348332-byte synthetic V2 FAILURE projects deterministically to 18870 bytes, preserving authoritative identities, digest bindings, 24303 report counts and 84 failed identities while excluding private diagnostics and raw report content.

Canonical decoding, reducer reconciliation and Operator correction boundaries validate projected FAILURE metadata and exact private/public correspondence without granting PASS, baseline comparability or reusable verification authority.
Unified State excludes well-formed transport sidecars from terminal discovery, including sidecars without matching RUNs, and retains rejection of real orphan terminals and malformed lifecycle data.

Established small diagnostic FAILURE and RESULT redaction remains supported; prospective FAILURE publication rejects undeclared diagnostic fields, and shared reader gates reject excessive bytes, nesting, malformed projections and declared-public captured output.

Added the failure_transport_recovery synthetic regression family covering large projection, remote canonical roundtrip, historical reader limits, local sidecars, lifecycle rejection and Operator private/public correction admission.

The committed delta is confined to the six authorized paths. Historical terminals, Kernel, verification engine, worker settings, review, publication, roadmap and execution authorization were not modified.
